name: io.github.cdrn/sigil
description: Claude can sign, but never see. MCP server + CLI that lets agentic coding tools use private keys without ever putting key material in the model's context window. Encrypted-at-rest keyfiles (Argon2id + XChaCha20-Poly1305); explicit out-of-band unlock via `sigil unlock` so the agent has no path to trigger key loading; hash-chained audit log; PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks that block reads of common key paths and redact key-shaped strings from tool output. Signs EIP-191 personal_sign, EIP-1559 + legacy transactions, EIP-712 typed data.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Override the default ~/.sigil directory for keyfiles, audit log, and control socket.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_CONTROL_SOCK
environmentVariables.description: Override the default control socket path (~/.sigil/control.sock).
